title: 4.3 Rotations

icans: I can rotate a figure 90°, 180°, or 270° about the origin.
I can perform a composition with a rotation.
I can tell whether a figure has rotational symmetry.

vocab: a _________________ in which a figure is turned about a fixed point, the center of rotation
the angle __________ which a figure is turned (counterclockwise unless stated)
a __________ has rotational symmetry when a rotation of 180° or less maps it onto itself

blocks.p: Plot P(3, 1). Rotate it counterclockwise about the origin with tracing paper.
What patterns do you see in the coordinates?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Rotations about the origin (counterclockwise): 90°: (x, y) → _______________; 180°: (x, y) → _______________; 270°: (x, y) → (y, −x).

blocks.stem: Rotate △JKL 90° about the origin. Give the image’s vertices.

notes: Rotational symmetry: a figure has it when a rotation of _______________ or less (about its center) maps it onto itself.
